statements.impact_statement: In both the main interpreter and AWS CLI venv, only pip 26.2.1's pure-Python vendored copy has this version in Zeus. pip's cache serializer uses one-shot pack/unpack calls and does not reuse a streaming Unpacker after errors. The separately installed msgpack is 1.2.3. This assessment is limited to the pinned pip bundle.

pip 26.2.1 vendors only pkg_resources from setuptools 70.3.0; it does not include setuptools/package_index.py containing the vulnerable PackageIndex.download code. The separately installed setuptools is 84.0.0. This assessment is limited to the pinned pip bundle.

In both the main interpreter and AWS CLI venv, pip 26.2.1 vendors only pkg_resources from setuptools 70.3.0. It ships neither setuptools nor jaraco.context, whose tarball extraction function contains CVE-2026-23949. Build and smoke checks assert the affected files are absent from the complete pip vendor tree. Standalone setuptools is 84.0.0. This assessment is limited to the pinned pip bundle and does not establish Xray clearance.
